title: NEO AI Evaluations - evidence packs and public verifier
description:
Evidence packs of the official tests of LILI, the AI system of NEO AI, and the public verifier that recomputes their published figures.

Each release archives the repository as it stood when the evidence pack of an official test was complete: the protocol and its targets, published and time-stamped before the run; the results, sealed in a hash-chained ledger and time-stamped by third parties; the per-task results; and the tasks drawn by a public source of randomness, published in full. The tag of the release names the test (for example test-4-2026-11-23 for Official Test No. 4).

Verifiable by anyone: node verify/cli.mjs verify packs/<test>. A pack attests the integrity and the dates of the published files and lets a reader recompute every published figure; it does not prove how the run was conducted. No external party has supervised, reproduced or audited the tests.
notes: Software (verify/, the workflow) is under the MIT licence; the data of the evidence packs are under CC BY 4.0. Publisher: NEO TECH LABS TECHNOLOGY L.L.C.
